## workflow comment

Comment on an issue, in Jira or on the forge, with the text on standard input

### Synopsis

Comment on an issue with the text read from standard input to its end — as
`git commit -F -` reads a message — so a script never quotes it; at a terminal,
end the text with Ctrl+D. A Jira issue's comment is written in Markdown and
posted as Jira's markup when jira.markdown_comments is on, as the interface
posts one; a forge issue's is Markdown. The comment, as it will be stored, is
printed and confirmed before it is posted.

```
workflow comment <issue> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  git log -1 --format=%B | workflow comment PROJ-7 --yes   # the text on stdin, never quoted
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for comment
  -y, --yes    go ahead without the confirmation
```
